Play Small Sided Football at Club Langley

If you’re looking to hire a 5 a side or 6 a side football pitch in South London, Club Langley offers excellent facilities for both casual games and competitive fixtures. Our newly refurbished 3G astroturf pitches provide a high quality playing surface, and the surrounding floodlights ensure great visibility all year round.

Whether you’re organising a one off match or planning a regular weekly game, we can accommodate your needs.

Simple Online Booking

All pitches can be booked online, and no membership is required. For regular players, block bookings via Playfinder are available — ideal for securing a consistent weekly slot with your team.

Changing Facilities

Changing rooms are available on site, making it easy for players coming straight from work or heading out afterwards.

Travel Information

The nearest station is Eden Park, just a short walk from the venue.

Parking

The venue is easily accessible by car, with:
• Free parking after 4 PM (Mon–Fri)
• Free parking all weekend

Serving the Local Football Community

Club Langley is a popular choice for grassroots footballers across Bromley, Croydon, and South Lewisham, offering reliable facilities, flexible booking options, and a welcoming environment for all players.
